meta.name: app-store-optimization
meta.description: Improves visibility and conversion in the App Store and Google Play — metadata, keywords, screenshots, ratings, and the listing experience that turns an impression into an install. Use this to audit or optimize an app listing, plan a launch listing, diagnose poor install conversion, or improve store search visibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化应用商店页面,提升曝光和下载量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有应用要上架,正为下载量和曝光发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize your app store listing to boost visibility and downloads.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching or managing a mobile app and need more installs.

howto.what: Claude 会先判断应用在商店里是「搜不到」还是「看了不装」,对应给出元数据(标题、关键词、描述、分类)和截图、评分等优化建议,并指导回复差评和做测试。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计或优化 App Store / Google Play 的应用列表、规划新应用上架、诊断安装转化问题等时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个 App 的商店列表,找出影响下载转化的点。
say.note: 会先定位是「被发现」还是「被安装」环节出问题。

say.text: 我准备上架一款新应用,帮我规划标题、关键词和截图。
say.note: 会基于商店索引规则给出建议。

say.text: 最近曝光没变但安装少了,帮我排查原因。
say.note: 会从评分、评论、截图等逐项检查。

howto.what_en: Claude first determines whether the issue is being found or being installed once found, then gives optimization advice for metadata (title, keywords, description, category), screenshots, ratings, and guides responding to reviews and running tests.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user asks to audit or optimize an App Store/Google Play listing, plan a new app launch, or diagnose poor install conversion, etc.

say_en.text: Audit this app's store listing and find what's hurting conversion.
say_en.note: It first identifies whether the issue is discoverability or install conversion.

say_en.text: I'm launching a new app—help plan title, keywords, and screenshots.
say_en.note: It advises based on store indexing rules.

say_en.text: Impressions are flat but installs dropped—help diagnose why.
say_en.note: It checks ratings, reviews, screenshots, etc.
